mapper.sql: id, driver_id, delivery_task_id, order_id, delivery_fee, bonus, penalty, settlement_amount, settlement_status, settlement_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM driver_settlement WHERE driver_id = #{driverId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM driver_settlement WHERE driver_id = #{driverId} AND settlement_status = #{settlementStatus} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO driver_settlement (id, driver_id, delivery_task_id, order_id, delivery_fee, bonus, penalty, settlement_amount, settlement_status, settlement_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{driverId}, #{deliveryTaskId}, #{orderId}, #{deliveryFee}, #{bonus}, #{penalty}, #{settlementAmount}, #{settlementStatus}, #{settlementTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE driver_settlement SET settlement_status = #{newStatus}, settlement_time = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 20 THEN NOW() ELSE settlement_time END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND settlement_status = #{expectedStatus} AND deleted = 0
